Weather Alerts & Threshold Watch

Distinguishes between official government warnings and forecast threshold advisories.

🏛️

Official Government Warnings (IMD CAP Feed)

Verified Live Feed Not Connected

Verified official warnings from the India Meteorological Department (IMD) require a direct CAP/API feed. Smart Kisan never invents official government warnings. For active district red/orange/yellow alerts, please check the official IMD Mausam portal directly.

🌐 IMD Mausam Official Bulletins ↗ 📡 RMC Mumbai / Pune Regional Warnings ↗

Forecast-Based Agricultural Watch (Not Official Warnings)

Forecast watch items above are calculated automatically from meteorological model thresholds (Heavy Rain ≥ 35 mm/day, Heatwave ≥ 40°C, Strong Wind ≥ 30 km/h) to assist farm preparation.

    About Smart Kisan

    Built for Maharashtra's Farming Community

    Smart Kisan brings hyper-local village weather forecasts, stage-wise crop care guidance, and APMC market visibility into one accessible, multilingual web portal—usable on any mobile browser or computer without forced registration.

    ✅ Integration & Honesty Status

    • • Cascading Location Dataset: Genuinely working for all 36 Maharashtra districts + 115+ talukas/villages with real GPS coordinates.
    • • Multilingual UI: Complete live dictionary in English, मराठी (Marathi), and हिंदी (Hindi).
    • • Weather & 7-Day Forecast: Wired to Open-Meteo API (no key needed) + optional OpenWeatherMap key, with automatic fallback to clearly labelled Demo Weather Data when offline.
    • • Supabase `farmer_profiles`: Full client code & RLS-ready schema integrated; add your project URL & publishable `anon` key in the Setup modal.

    API Keys, Supabase & GitHub Pages Setup

    1. Connect Your Existing Supabase Project (`farmer_profiles`)

    Paste your Supabase Project URL and public publishable `anon` key below (from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Never paste your `service_role` secret key in the browser.

    2. Weather & Mandi API Configuration (Optional)

    By default, Smart Kisan uses Open-Meteo for live coordinates weather without requiring an API key. If you also have an OpenWeatherMap API key or a data.gov.in (Agmarknet) API key, you can enter them below:

    3. Publishing to GitHub Pages (`SmartKiran-S/Smart-Kisan-`)

    Both this standalone `index.html` and the downloadable React + Vite project zip (`smart_kisan_project.zip` with `base: '/Smart-Kisan-/'` pre-configured) are ready to push to https://github.com/SmartKiran-S/Smart-Kisan-.
